name_reason: Conforms to fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> (domain=player, descriptor=inline_action_menu_dispatch). No address residue. Accurately names the inline Attack/Spell/Item/Wait action submenu opened after the player picks a destination tile, and 'dispatch' fits the selection-dispatch switch in the body.
purpose: Player inline action submenu (Attack / Spell / Item / Wait) shown after the player picks a destination tile; gates the four slots by availability, runs the menu input loop, then dispatches the chosen action.
logic_summary: Stack-probe prologue __CHK(0xB0). Copies the 4-int inline_action_menu_template {0,1,2,3} into a local. Gating: Attack disabled if no weapon equipped (fd2_find_equipped_item_by_kind==0xFFFFFFFF) or weapon AoE finds no targets at the cursor tile; Item disabled if fd2_count_usable_inventory_slots==0; Spell disabled if fd2_build_usable_spell_list==0 or unit is silenced (combat_aux_block[0]!=0). Opens the slide-in settings dialog, loops fd2_settings_menu_input_step until non-zero, closes the dialog, composites the frame. On cancel (-1) returns -1. Otherwise dispatches on data_fd2_ui_menu_cursor_idx: case0 Attack=malloc(100) target-id buffer, recompute AoE targets, target-input pick (cancel -> pan back, return 0), face+combat cinematic+damage, clear facing, collect death drops, death animation, process loot drops, mark acted, clear keyboard; case1 Spell=loop fd2_spell_selection_menu_main (cancel -> return 0), mark acted, then pending_xp_credit /= cast_divisor where cast_divisor = status_flags_block[0] (character level), +30 when job_id>8 (promoted/advanced class); case2 Item=loop fd2_item_command_menu_dispatch (cancel -> return 0), pending_xp_credit=0; default Wait=if have_moved==0 fd2_ai_pass_turn_with_heal (20% HP recover), then fd2_handle_tile_event_interaction, mark acted. Returns 1 on a committed action.

params.name: char_idx
params.semantics: Index of the acting player character into data_fd2_battle_runtime_char_array_ptr (the runtime_char being given the action). Passed straight through from fd2_player_action_menu_loop, which got it from fd2_game_main_loop's selected unit.
params.reason: Descriptive; standard char-index name used throughout the battle code. No address residue.

params.name: pSlot_disable_arr
params.semantics: Pointer to the caller's 4-int menu state/gating array (menu_state in fd2_player_action_menu_loop). Element non-zero = that slot (0=Attack,1=Spell,2=Item,3=Wait) is disabled/greyed. The function writes [0],[1],[2] based on availability and passes the array to the dialog/input helpers.
params.reason: Name accurately conveys it is a per-slot disable array passed by pointer. No address residue.

params.name: have_moved
params.semantics: 1 if the character actually walked to a new tile this action (caller's path-walked branch), 0 if it acts in place. Only consulted in the Wait case: the 20%-HP heal (fd2_ai_pass_turn_with_heal) is applied only when have_moved==0 (didn't move).
params.reason: Boolean-ish flag with a clear, accurate name matching its single use site. No address residue.

returns.semantics: 1 = action committed (advance turn); -1 = cancelled all the way out of the submenu (caller treats as full cancel); 0 = inner sub-step was cancelled, re-prompt the outer menu (caller loops fd2_player_inline_action_menu_dispatch until non-zero).

comment_original_issue: The src comment block described the Spell-case XP divisor as 'status_flags_block[0], +30 for job_id > 8 priest/cleric'. Two inaccuracies: status_flags_block[0] is the character LEVEL (verified struct types.h: +0x21 [0]=level), and 'priest/cleric' is wrong -- job_id>8 covers all promoted/advanced classes (09h+); the actual priest 僧侶 is job 06h (<=8). The Ghidra plate carried the same misleading 'priest/cleric class AP cost mod' note.
notes: Single caller: fd2_player_action_menu_loop @ 0x18890 (2 call sites: have_moved=0 for the act-in-place path, have_moved=1 after a path walk). Template confirmed: data_fd2_ui_inline_action_menu_template[4]={0,1,2,3} (src/table/uitab.c:48). Field semantics verified against src/include/types.h: status_flags_block +0x21 [0]=level; combat_aux_block +0x27 [0]=silence. Job IDs confirmed via fd2-knowledge: 06h=僧侶(priest, <=8), 08h=武者, 09h=劍聖 (first job >8). Refined src comment to call the divisor the character level and the +30 a promoted/advanced-class modifier (not priest/cleric); updated Ghidra plate to match and saved program. Only the symbol's own comment block was edited via Edit; no logic/types/signature changed. No rename needed (name + all 3 params keep).
